title: Distinguish zero state and W state
titleZh: 区分零态和 W 态
statementMd:
You are given $*N*$ qubits ($2 ≤ *N* ≤ 8$) which are guaranteed to be in one of the two states:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8bb67080da7081bfb802ca6ecc5abc4f4c5ca190.png) state, or
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6c9f6af141e015f20a73dd1c0e8749da68f71ba6.png) state. Your task is to perform necessary operations and measurements to figure out which state it was and to return 0 if it was ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/98f5a3251cafe82f85c52d61d5fabda714cbe4ac.png) state or 1 if it was W state. The state of the qubits after the operations does not matter.You have to implement an operation which takes an array of $*N*$ qubits as an input and returns an integer. - ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6c9f6af141e015f20a73dd1c0e8749da68f71ba6.png) 态。

你的任务是执行必要的操作和测量，以判断它们处于哪种状态：如果是 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/98f5a3251cafe82f85c52d61d5fabda714cbe4ac.png) 态，则返回 0；如果是 W 态，则返回 1。操作之后量子比特的状态无关紧要。
